subject: Request: latest pen test report & encrypted delivery for hosted API
messages:
From: Sam Carter <sam.carter@northbridge.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: securityops@northbridge.com
Date: 2026-12-18T08:14:00-05:00
Subject: Request for latest penetration test report (hosted API)

Hi Rishi,

Hope you’re well. Northbridge’s compliance team is preparing an external risk review and we need the most recent penetration test report that covers Redwood’s hosted API (production). Can you confirm:

- The latest report date and scope (which endpoints / subsystems were tested).
- Whether the report includes verified remediation for the CVE-2026-1742 and CVE-2026-1987 findings (or a remediation timeline).
- Your preferred secure delivery method. We typically accept either an AES-256 encrypted ZIP delivered via secure S3 presigned URL plus a separate key exchange, or dedicated SFTP with a one-time SSH key.

We need the report for our audit team by EOD 2026-12-22. Please let me know if that’s feasible and what access method you prefer.

Thanks,
Sam Carter
Security Program Manager
Northbridge Systems
sam.carter@northbridge.com
+1 415-555-0123

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sam Carter <sam.carter@northbridge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-18T10:02:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest penetration test report (hosted API)

Hi Sam — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide the November 2026 penetration test report that covers the hosted API control plane and data plane (public API endpoints, auth, and routing layer). Summary answers up front:

- Report date/scope: Penetration test completed 2026-11-11; scope: hosted API (production), auth service, token handling, and gateway routing.
- CVE-2026-1742 & CVE-2026-1987: both were addressed in our Nov patch cycle; remediation verification is documented in the remediation_summary_2026-11.csv that we can provide alongside the report.
- Delivery: We prefer to share a password-protected AES-256 ZIP via a short-lived pre-signed S3 URL and exchange the password over a verified phone call or through a PGP-encrypted message to securityops@northbridge.com. If you require SFTP instead, we can stand up a one-time SFTP user and provide a one-time SSH key.

We can aim to have the package ready by 2026-12-20 if you confirm the preferred delivery method and the person to receive the encryption key.

Best,
Rishi
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Office: +1 650-555-0199

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-18T10:07:00-05:00
Subject: Fwd: Request for latest penetration test report (hosted API)

Team — forwarding Sam's request. Quick notes on what we should include in the package and redaction policy so we’re aligned before we send:

- Deliverables: full pen test PDF, remediation CSV (columns: finding_id, severity, status, verified_date, mitigation_notes), and a short cover letter summarizing scope and test vendor.
- Redactions: remove internal-only IP addresses, customer tenant identifiers, and any internal ticket IDs that map to customers. Keep vulnerability descriptions and remediation evidence intact for auditor review.
- Verification evidence: for the two CVEs call out the commit ids, patch notes, and verification test logs (sanitized) — Vivek can confirm whether logs need further redaction.
- Delivery method: I recommend AES-256 ZIP on S3 + phone exchange for password. Ops: we'll create the ZIP and upload to our secure bucket with a 48-hour presigned URL.

Can Laura confirm legal/NDA clearance for delivering the full report to Northbridge and whether we need their signed NP/ND (I think we do)? Vivek — can you estimate time to generate the remediation CSV and sanitized verification artifacts?

Thanks — R

On 2026-12-18 Sam Carter <sam.carter@northbridge.com> wrote:
> (original request pasted above)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sam Carter <sam.carter@northbridge.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T09:18:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest penetration test report (hosted API)

Hi Sam — thanks for the patience. I’ve reviewed the request with our security and legal teams. We can share the pen test package under the following terms:

- Package contents: redwood_pen_test_report_2026-11.pdf (full report, vendor redacted per policy where required) and remediation_summary_2026-11.csv.
- Redaction/retention: internal IPs and customer-specific identifiers have been redacted. The report still contains the vulnerability details and remediation verification notes you need.
- Delivery mechanism: we will upload an AES-256 encrypted ZIP to our secure S3 bucket with a 72-hour pre-signed URL. We will provide the decryption password to the Northbridge security contact by verified phone call to the number you provided. If you prefer a PGP key for the password exchange, send a pubkey to securityops@northbridge.com and we’ll use that instead.
- Timeline: files will be uploaded and the URL sent to you by 2026-12-20 14:00 PST.

Attachments: redwood_pen_test_report_2026-11.pdf (attachment stub), remediation_summary_2026-11.csv (attachment stub).

Please confirm the phone number to call for the password exchange and whether we should use PGP instead. I’ve copied Vivek who produced the remediation CSV and can answer any technical questions.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0211

From: Sam Carter <sam.carter@northbridge.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: securityops@northbridge.com
Date: 2026-12-20T15:02:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest penetration test report (hosted API)

Thanks Laura — that works. Please call my direct line +1 415-555-0123 after you send the S3 URL and we’ll confirm receipt of the password. We will also provide a signed NDA addendum via DocuSign; please send the link when ready.

Two quick asks from our compliance team:
- Could you include the test vendor name in the cover letter (we need to log third-party testers)? If vendor naming is an issue, let us know and we can accept the report under NDA-only with a vendor disclosure to our audit team.
- We may also request a short SOC2 annex that highlights where the tested systems map to the SOC2 trust services criteria — if available, please attach or indicate where to find it.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Sam
Security Program Manager
Northbridge Systems
